_comment: Video candidates for the video block. Curated, not scraped.
Every id here came out of Deutsche Welle's own YouTube playlist feeds and is
re-verified against YouTube's oEmbed endpoint by `npm run videos`, which
refuses to seed an id that has been deleted or made unembeddable.
SEGMENTS ARE DELIBERATELY EMPTY. A video only reaches a learner once it has
hand-marked segments (session.ts checks that), so nothing here shows up in a
session yet. Marking them is ~10 minutes each in /admin/video, and it is the
part that has to be done by a person: you have to hear the line to timestamp
it. Generated 'transcripts' would be subtitles that do not match the audio.
unit_id is set ONLY where the episode title and the unit's can-do statement
say the same thing. Everything else is level-tagged and unassigned — placing
it is a judgement best made while watching, which is when you are segmenting

source.channel: Deutsche Welle — Deutsch lernen mit der DW
source.why: A free A1-B1 drama course from a public broadcaster, already cut into short lesson-sized episodes with the syllabus DeutschMate follows. Embedding is what the YouTube player is for; nothing is downloaded and no captions are scraped.
source.licence: Standard YouTube embed. DW permits embedding; the video is served by YouTube and stays on their terms.
source.coverage_note: YouTube's playlist pages are behind a consent wall, and its RSS feeds return only the newest 15 entries per playlist. That is why this stops at A1 episode 14 rather than covering all ~76. Add more with: npm run videos -- --from-playlist <PLAYLIST_ID>
